# growdigitalbranding — growdigitalbranding.com

> Performance marketing for high-consideration purchases — real estate first, then senior
> living and interiors. The core argument: most agencies stop at the lead; Grow runs the
> whole loop across four stations — creative volume, tracking signal, follow-up speed, and
> AI search visibility — with closed-won data flowing back into the ad account.

## Key pages

- /the-loop — the methodology, in depth
- /who-we-help/real-estate — lead quality benchmarks by ticket size, RERA constraints, CP vs. direct leads
- /what-we-do — the five services that make up the loop
- /pricing — real engagement pricing, no "contact us for a quote"
- /tracking-setup — the exact measurement stack running on this site
- /tools/cpl-calculator — turns ad spend + funnel rates into cost per booking

## Published articles

- /insights/good-cost-per-lead-real-estate — what a good cost per lead is for a real estate project, the cost-per-booking formula, and a worked example where fixing two downstream rates cuts cost per booking 44% with CPL unchanged
- /insights/rera-approval-status-lead-quality — how RERA registration and DTCP approval status in the creative raise cost per lead and lower cost per booking, and what can legitimately run before registration
- /insights/channel-partner-vs-direct-leads — brokerage against media cost per booking worked at a ₹75L ticket, and the three asymmetries that decide it
- /insights/speed-to-lead-real-estate — why contact rate is the cheapest rate to move, a 29% cut in cost per booking from contact rate alone, and how to build your own speed-to-lead decay curve from call logs
- /insights/why-meta-lead-ads-poor-quality — why Meta optimises toward form fillers rather than buyers, what the platform cannot see after the form, and the three levels of feedback that change lead quality
- /insights/how-many-ad-creatives-real-estate — deriving creative volume from frequency accrual, winner lifespan and hit rate, with a worked example landing between 12 and 29 new creatives a month
- /insights/get-cited-by-ai-assistants — the three tests that decide whether an AI assistant cites you: server-rendered content, an entity that resolves to one organisation, and published material specific enough to quote

## Terms this site defines

- **Loop marketing** — running creative, tracking, follow-up, and booking-data feedback as one closed system, instead of media buying alone.
- **Signal layer** — the server-side tracking (CAPI, sGTM, offline conversions) that tells ad platforms which leads actually became bookings.
- **Cost per booking** — the metric that matters over cost per lead: what it actually costs to close a customer, not just generate an inquiry.
